checkpoints.name: Adelaide aid (after the Ball Mountain loop)

description: From E 6th St in Leadville (10,150 ft) on old mining roads and 4WD tracks: around Iron Hill to Adelaide, the Ball Mountain loop to 11,950 ft, past Resurrection and up Mosquito Pass Road to the turnaround at Mosquito Pass (13,185 ft), back down to Resurrection, a shorter return loop over the same valley, and back to town. The steepest course here: grades up to about 18%, capped by the treadmill. Unofficial.

source.notes: The 2024–2026 course to the summit of Mosquito Pass (snow has occasionally turned the race short of it). Route traced over the county roads and 4WD tracks of the Leadville mining district on OpenStreetMap, following the organiser's course map; the race is uncertified and states 26.4 miles, so distances are scaled to 26.4 miles between the Mosquito Pass turnaround and the finish and compared with the aid stations' published mileages. Elevations from USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar (three surveys, which agree within centimetres). Grades above your treadmill's maximum are capped, and downhills are flat without decline. The altitude, 10,150–13,190 ft, can't be simulated. Unofficial.
